notes: Small additive refresher-method build. RA, COSHH RA and SSW training settings now separate the initial training method from the repeat/refresher method. After the repeat frequency, Managers select Self-training or Instructor-led for future refreshers. Changing the refresher method does not invalidate a completion that is still current; the new method takes effect when the scheduled refresher becomes due. Existing per-person instructor overrides and valid training-pack instructor requirements remain stricter and still win. Toolbox Talks are locked to Instructor-led for both initial training and every refresher. The setting is stored on controlled documents/training records and changes are audit logged with Manager and date. Existing data is backfilled to preserve current behaviour until a Manager changes the refresher method. Supabase migration refresher_delivery_method_v21060 applied. Ad-hoc Retrain now remains the next separate small build.
